title: [Feature request] Allow users to set a preferred application for the Media Player widget
line: The Media Player widget has a new "Preferred player" setting, and it always controls that player whenever it is running.
explanation: The Media Player widget always started on the player picked automatically (the playing one, or else the first one found), and had no settings at all, so with several players open it often controlled the wrong one (e.g. KDE Connect instead of Clementine). Picking the right tab by hand was lost every time the player was closed and reopened, which also broke scroll and middle-click on the panel icon. The widget now has a General settings page with a "Preferred player" combo box (None, the running players, and the saved one), and libkmpris' Mpris2Model selects that player whenever it appears, at startup and when the setting changes.

commits.message:
applets/mediacontroller: add a preferred player option

The widget always followed the player chosen automatically, so people
with one main player had to pick it by hand again every time it started.
Add a preferred player setting that the widget switches to when it runs.

BUG: 455046

media.caption: Before: the Media Player widget's menu has no settings.
After: "Configure Media Player…" is in the menu.
Before: with KDE Connect and Clementine open, the widget controls KDE Connect and Clementine has to be picked by hand after every restart.
After: with Clementine as preferred player, the panel widget opens on Clementine right after both players start (the desktop widget, left unconfigured, still picks KDE Connect).
After: the new settings page with the Preferred player list.
